timeline.labelEn: First issue of the Amsterdam daily newspaper De Telegraaf
timeline.labelDe: Erstausgabe der Amsterdamer Tageszeitung De Telegraaf

questions.notes: The card's claim is false: De Telegraaf is Dutch (seat in Amsterdam), not Danish. Founded 1892 by Henry Tindal; first issue 1 January 1893.
